answer: Standing decays with idle time the way heat leaves a tundra surface, and what remains is weighted by the length of independent paths to the identity. Each close, the scorer walks the graph from known operators and applies a multiplier per hop, so a node vouched only by its own siblings sits at the bottom of a canyon. Concrete case: an identity reached through four unrelated clients keeps most of its score after a quiet week, while a vault of a thousand idle keys behind one operator reads near zero. Reviving that stock needs fresh work on separate paths before it can vote or grade.
